When the operation completes or is canceled, the loop writes the result into the freed frame and calls `ownerCallback`, which locks a freed `CompletionQueue` mutex and pushes into a freed list: a use-after-free. `src/completion_queue.zig:22-36` states the contract for frame-owned operations, and every test in that file uses `defer cq.cancelAll(.discard)` for exactly this reason.
